features.name: Outcome-Driven Project Showcase
features.description: Hardcoded bento-grid portfolio displaying case studies for regulated industries with a clear 'Outcome -> Problem -> Solution' structure.
acceptance_criteria: Case studies lead with a bold outcome metric (the 'hook')
Each project includes distinct sections for Outcome, Problem, and Solution
Visual design uses modern, 'disruptive' elements (grids, glassmorphism)
Staggered entry animations using Framer Motion
Responsive layout optimized for high-end desktop and mobile devices
features.notes: No CMS; projects are statically defined in the codebase for maximum control.

features.name: Direct Contact Page
features.description: Clean, high-conversion contact page with clear ways for prospects to initiate manual 1-to-1 SMS or Email outreach.
acceptance_criteria: Contact options include SMS and Email with direct links (mailto:, tel: / sms:)
Modern, 'no-BS' UI focused on direct connection
Contact actions tracked via PostHog
features.notes: Facilitates personal, high-touch communication for agency lead-generation.

features.name: Disruptive Brand Visuals
features.description: High-end UI framework using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion to convey a disruptive but stable image.
acceptance_criteria: Dark mode default with premium glassmorphism effects
Intentional motion and transitions (e.g., counting up outcome numbers)
Strict typography (e.g., Inter or Geist) for technical trust
features.notes: Key differentiator from stale competitors in regulated spaces.

features.name: Type-Safe Routing
features.description: File-based or code-based routing with full TypeScript inference on route params, search params, and loader data via @tanstack/react-router.
acceptance_criteria: All routes defined with createRoute/createRootRoute and registered via RouterProvider
Route params and search params are fully type-safe (no runtime type assertions)
Navigation between portfolio pages and contact page works without full page reloads
Route type registration via 'declare module @tanstack/react-router' is in place
features.notes: Enabled by @tanstack/react-router v1.168.10. Code-based routing for MVP; file-based routing available via @tanstack/router-plugin.

features.name: Server State Caching
features.description: Async data fetching with automatic caching, background refetching, and stale-while-revalidate via @tanstack/react-query.
acceptance_criteria: QueryClient and QueryClientProvider wrap the application root
Data fetching uses useQuery with typed queryFn return values
Stale-while-revalidate strategy is configured for portfolio data
Loading and error states are handled in all data-dependent components
features.notes: Enabled by @tanstack/react-query v5.97.0. Supports future API integrations beyond hardcoded data.

features.name: Headless Data Tables
features.description: Custom-styled, headless data tables for displaying structured portfolio metrics and case study data via @tanstack/react-table.
acceptance_criteria: Tables use useReactTable with typed ColumnDef definitions
Sorting and filtering are available where appropriate
Table rendering matches the bento-grid premium aesthetic (no default component library styles)
Responsive table layouts for mobile and desktop
features.notes: Enabled by @tanstack/react-table v8.21.3. Headless design ensures tables match the premium Flowtress visual identity.

features.name: Type-Safe Contact Forms
features.description: Form management with type-safe field validation and submission via @tanstack/react-form.
acceptance_criteria: Forms use useForm with fully typed defaultValues and onSubmit
Field-level validation with onChange/onBlur handlers
Form submission state (isSubmitting, canSubmit) is reflected in UI
TypeScript strict mode enabled (required by @tanstack/react-form)
features.notes: Enabled by @tanstack/react-form v1.28.6. Requires TypeScript strict mode and v5.4+.
